lines: — DAY 90 DAWN — The world wakes. Animals are active.
The village threw out spoiled stores: Foraged food, Snared meat. (pantry)
"Your showbiz fans voted you "most watchable human" three weeks running. The trophy is a small moon."
◈ THE TABLE IS SET. A ring of pale light waits — take your seat from Haven when you are ready. Nothing is final until you sit.
You wake with a start — something is wrong.
📺 You study Suradet. The hands are steady. Too steady. Performed calm.
📺 You press. The story wobbles — the poison, the hour, the hands. Real guilt is consistent. This isn't. Suradet won't stop looking at the back row.
📺 You press on the details and the details fall apart. The time is wrong. The method is wrong. The grief, though — the grief is real.
📺 Dusk is coming. The System waits with the patience of weather. The verdict is yours. The consequences are everyone's.
📺 You name the real one — someone the village loves. The crowd goes silent. You were right. The village doesn't thank you.
📺 The Confession — YOU WIN. The crowd is a weather system.
📈 your showbiz fans +6 — won The Confession on camera (favor: 59)
📦 A care package drops from the sky with a little parachute. There's a note: "WE LOVE YOU! — your showbiz fans"
Inside: Phase sling
Plus 51 kcal of fan-approved snacks.
📺 Prize: the System's favor (and a story). The vault was feeling shy tonight.
📺 The lights take their cut. Winning marks you. (-5 health.)
📺 You won. Your hands won't stop shaking for a while. (+4 trauma.)
No risky water to boil.
Drank clean water.
📋 Suradet — 💧 Fetch water. Suradet nods eagerly. They'll report back by next part.

◈ THE TABLE — it is not a table. It's a ring of pale light, and around it, things with too many angles to be faces. Above it all — the audience. Trillions of eyes, and every one of them knows your name. The System speaks, and for once it isn't performing: "HUMANITY PRESENTS ITS CASE."

◈ THE AUDIT — the System reads your run back to you, and the galaxy listens. A lesser seat — national standing, waves 1–3 faced (14/9/4), 10 contests survived, 3 crises weathered. The table does not rise. It prices.
EVERYONE. SIT. WATCH. The teeth and the weather can WAIT — nothing out there matters until this is done. ...Did I stutter? SIT.
💧 Suradet returns with 17L of creek water. Risky until the hearth boils it.
You catch fragments by the fire — Wanjiru telling Caleb about you. Half of it's true anymore. You're not sure which half.
🪤 Wanjiru is back. "Snares were empty. They'll keep."
📖 Suradet is walking Chantal through the lacy white flower heads on tall stems; thin pale roots — leaf, stem, smell, the beginner's tour.
Iron cold. Even the ticks are shelved.
— MIDDAY — Honest work hours. Heat builds.
You wait. The light changes. Nothing asks anything of you.
You catch fragments by the fire — Wanjiru telling Kemal about you. The retelling is already better than the event.
Wanjiru heads out to forage. "Back before dark. Probably."
Someone's retelling it again — Suradet, out past the ridge. Farid says "Suradet would've gone farther if we'd let them."
— DUSK — Animals stir again. Shadows lengthen.
You wait. The light changes. Nothing asks anything of you.
📺 ● LIVE — THE FEAST. the whole village are on television.
📺 You are WATCHING. This is a scene playing out — not your life. Nobody dies on television. That is the rule. Probably.
📺 🎙️ PLAY-BY-PLAY: And we are LIVE with a special presentation: THE FEAST! The little ones are putting flavored matter in their mouths ON PURPOSE. For joy. The file says joy.
📺 🎨 COLOR: They cooked it. They did not have to cook it. They cooked it anyway and now they are SHARING it. I need to sit down.
📺 🎙️ PLAY-BY-PLAY: Look at that spread. Seventeen systems are watching and every one of them is hungry now. This is a war crime against our nutrient paste.
📺 Broadcast over — back to your life.

🍖 FEAST 📺 — Nikolai opens the pantry wide: 12× Foraged food. Suradet, Kemal, Chantal, Farid and 1 more eat until the fire burns low. Somebody laughs so hard they cry. For one evening, nobody is surviving — they're just together. (−2,400 kcal from the pantry) The channeled keepsake feeds the feast — the feast was the weapon, and the surge rides the fire until tomorrow's dawn, spent only when the

🍖 The feast is warm and good — but your reactor hums its steady note underneath, and the fire never catches. 1.25x, always, is all there is. (Feast buff refused: the reactor is a ceiling as well as a floor.)
Chantal sets out to find Wanjiru. "Won't be long."
Suradet is down by the firepit, nudging coals back into the middle.
Caleb is working the broom along the hall floor, slow and thorough.
— NIGHT — Camp. Rest — or risk the dark.
Night. The treeline is just a sound now. The fire is the whole argument against it.
You wait. The light changes. Nothing asks anything of you.
◈ ABILITY — Spotlight: The room is already warm. Audience starts at 2.
◈ ABILITY — Callback: One bad act can be redone. (Offered once, after a bad beat.)
◈ ABILITY — Standing-O: Genuine love doesn't crater: the audience can't fall below 0 while you hold it.
◈ ABILITY — Eulogy: The quiet ones' act lands harder than any headliner. (Offered in the final beat.)
🔴 LIVE! the variety finale: ONE NIGHT ONLY

◈ THE BELOVED — The audience is chanting. You don't know the words — it isn't a language with words — but you know the feeling. The table can't move against the cast's favorite. That's leverage. Tonight, the cast is your village.
The table has read your ledger. The protected outnumber the killed; the food truth was shared. The light road is open.
Suradet tells the hunt — the real one, with the fear left in. The audience goes silent in the good way. Silence, at this scale, is deafening.
The feast song — the one about eating like it matters, because it does. Trillions of beings who never ate anything hear it and feel hungry for the first time. The ratings spike is audible.

You spend it all — the love, the light, the finale slot — on people the cameras never found. You name the unfilmed villages. You name the dead. The audience weeps in eleven dimensions. This is what the show was for, it turns out.
◈ THE BELOVED — the last choice is yours, and it's live.
◈ THE BELOVED — "Let the audience speak."

The show becomes the government. Strange. It works. Trillions of viewers hold the table to account in real time, and humanity's seat is wherever the cameras are. You made popularity into a constitution — and constitutions, unlike ratings, don't dip.
◈ Nikolai Volkov walks out of the light alone, which is how he walked in. The village endures. That was always the story.
◈ THE OVERSIGHT —
You won. Say it plainly: you won. The village endures. The table signed. The galaxy applauds, and the applause is real, and you earned it.
And somewhere out there — past the cameras, past the light — in rows of humming glass, the little ones are still napping.
The System put a pod on the screen, and you let the segment play.
They are still there. Still small. Still waiting for someone to decide they matter more than the moment.

That is what the word means. Not the watching — anyone can watch. The oversight is the looking away. The most terrible thing the System ever did, it did by accident, because it was bored. You did it on purpose, because you were busy.
The village will tell your story for years. It will be a good story. Listen for the part they don't tell.
💛 You hold Dog Tags. Breathe. The shaking eases. (−6 trauma)
📋 Wanjiru — 🎣 Fish. Wanjiru nods eagerly. They'll report back by next part.
📋 Suradet — 🍲 Cook. Suradet nods eagerly. They'll report back by next part.
...and then it lands: Ingrid speaks 🇺🇸 English. A few shared words. Gestures. Patience.
